MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this Motor Command.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this Motor Command.

MotorCommandID.description: Unique identifier of this Motor Command instance.

MotorCommandTime.description: Time this Motor Command was produced.

MotorCommandSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Motor Command applies.

MotorID.description: Identifier of the motor to which this command is addressed.

ControlMode.description: Specifies which control modality is active.

MotorCommandTime.description: Time interval during which the command shall be applied.

TargetVelocity.description: Target motor output velocity (m/s). Valid when ControlMode = velocity.

TargetTorque.description: Target motor torque (N·m). Valid when ControlMode = torque.

TargetPosition.description: Target shaft or steering position (radians or degrees). Valid when ControlMode = position.

TargetAcceleration.description: Target acceleration (m/s²). Valid when ControlMode = acceleration.

ControlProfile.description: Optional multi-phase actuation profile (ramp-up, hold, ramp-down).

Duration.description: Duration of this phase in seconds.

SafetyLimits.description: Optional safety envelope for this command.

HealthAwareness.description: Optional health-aware parameters for this command.

ThermalDerating.description: Indicates whether thermal derating mode is active.

ExpectedLoad.description: Estimated load to be compensated (N·m or kg).

MotorStateHint.description: Optional hint from the motor-health subsystem.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Motor Command in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Motor Command (plain text, max 2048 characters).
